title: How Zhangye’s Rainbow Mountains Formed

scenes.label: RED SANDSTONE BASE
scenes.text: The foundation is red sandstone deposited 24‑million years ago.

scenes.label: MILLIONS OF YEARS OF LAYERING
scenes.text: Erosion and sedimentation added orange, yellow and green strata over time.

scenes.label: MINERAL OXIDES THAT SHINE

description: Zhangye Danxia’s rainbow mountains in Gansu, China, showcase a kaleidoscope of colors created by ancient sandstone, layered erosion, and mineral oxides. Discover the natural art behind these breathtaking cliffs.
